objective: Ejecutar exactamente una vez en EDARSAHUB Development la migracion versionada Gate8F de Catalogo Ampliado, usando la credencial SQL canonica existente previamente certificada con permisos suficientes. La ejecucion queda SHA256-bound, transaccional, con preflight y postcheck READ_ONLY fail-closed, sin SQL inline de escritura, sin segundo secreto y sin tocar Produccion.

queries.name: gate8f_writer_identity_permission_gate
queries.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND SUSER_SNAME()='HRLectura' AND USER_NAME()='HRLectura' AND OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','U') IS NOT NULL AND HAS_PERMS_BY_NAME('dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig','OBJECT','INSERT')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate8f_writer_preflight

queries.name: gate8f_baseline
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"smtp"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"twilio"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provider_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS template_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"modo_envio":"real"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS module_config_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1

queries.name: gate8f_postcheck_identity
queries.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN DB_NAME()='EDARSAHUB' AND SUSER_SNAME()='HRLectura' AND USER_NAME()='HRLectura' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate8f_postcheck_identity

queries.name: gate8f_materialization_gate
queries.sql: SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"smtp"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"twilio"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1) >= 2 AND (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1) >= 2 AND (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"modo_envio":"real"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1) >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate8f_materialization_ok

queries.name: gate8f_materialization_counts
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_provider_config' AND ((LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"smtp"%') OR (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"provider":"twilio"%')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS provider_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_templates' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado_documento_vencimiento%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS template_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN ColeccionOrigen='notification_config' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%catalogo_ampliado%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%documento_vencimiento%' AND LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"modo_envio":"real"%' AND (LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"email"%' OR LOWER(PayloadMongo) LIKE '%"canal":"whatsapp"%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS module_config_rows FROM dbo.Sistema_NotificacionesConfig WHERE Activo=1
